parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.conversation_id||!b.reason||!b.summary) throw new Error('conversation_id, reason and summary required'); return [{json:{conversation_id:b.conversation_id,reason:b.reason,priority:b.priority??'normal',summary:b.summary,recent_messages:(b.recent_messages??[]).slice(-20),destination:b.destination??'human'}}];

parameters.query: WITH c AS (UPDATE conversations SET status='waiting_human',updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING organization_id) INSERT INTO handoffs(organization_id,conversation_id,reason,priority,summary,recent_messages,destination) SELECT organization_id,$1::uuid,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6 FROM c RETURNING *;
